title: Statement Silver Mixed-Cut Crystal Wrap Ring
storyHtml:
Pear, round and baguette crystals tumble together in an open wrap, like a cluster caught mid-bloom. An open-front design that feels generous without ever feeling heavy.

Jewelry that marks your every becoming.
detailsBullets: Mixed-cut 5A clear zircon, open wrap setting
